title: Bubbles
copy: You meet a room full of people and leave with a phone full of half-typed numbers. [Bubbles](https://bubbles.fyi) fixes that: spin up one shareable link, everyone drops their details in, and you walk away with the whole group as vCards — no app, no account, no passing a phone around the table.

title: Personnel.fyi (in-progress)
copy: Great teams are built on great people — and by the time someone hands in their notice, the decision to leave was usually made months earlier. [Personnel.fyi](https://personnel.fyi) surfaces the leading indicators of attrition, the quiet signals that show up long before the resignation letter, so you can act while it still matters.

title: Overgraft (in-progress)
copy: Every platform renders your link differently, yet most sites ship one generic Open Graph card and hope for the best. Overgraft lets you craft a tailored preview per platform — the right image, title, and framing for X, LinkedIn, iMessage, and the rest — so a shared link looks intentional everywhere it lands.

title: Null Wines
copy: Brand, digital, and creative consulting for an early-stage non-alcoholic wine label. In a matter of weeks I audited the brand — its values, opinions, tone, and mannerisms — then designed packaging inserts, press materials, and a webstore, [nullwines.com](https://nullwines.com).
